new_written_lemma_violator_localisation: Let psi be pure with K3(X3)>6 and let V be a top-three eigenspace. CLIP excludes psi in V, so d:=1-<psi|P_V|psi> is in (0,1); write psi=sqrt(1-d)xi+sqrt(d)psi', xi in V, psi' a unit vector orthogonal to V. Pi4=P_V+|psi'><psi'| contains psi, and the parent-supported global k4 bound gives K3+<psi'|X3|psi'><=7, so <psi'|X3|psi'><1. Because V is X3-invariant, <xi|X3|psi'>=0, hence 2+R/2=<psi|X3|psi>=(1-d)<xi|X3|xi>+d<psi'|X3|psi'><4(1-d)+d, i.e. d<delta/6 with delta=4-R. Thus every U3(3) violator has its top-three eigenspace within d<delta/6 of containing psi, and its complementary direction has X3-expectation below1. Exact, written; not a closure (the containing-face slack is only second order in delta while the tilt gain is first order).
